notes: Opening stop: rubber bumper on a floor mount; the leaf face strikes its tip at the 90 deg limit.  A wall bumper cannot reach a leaf that stops perpendicular to its own wall, so the floor riser real doors use there is modelled instead.

the clutched outside hub is bored for the spindle
the spindle passes through the rose

forearm clevis enters the shoe around its pivot

keypad.source: Schlage FE595 keypad lever; 5 rows of 2 keys, tactile dome ~1.5-3 N, 3 wrong codes -> 30 s lockout
keypad.note: electronic keypad: the digits in order; a partial entry clears after 5 s, and 3 wrong codes lock the keypad out for 30 s.
